en.t: It seemed like a playful stroke of the brush.

units.source_text: 紫姬做梦也不曾想到源氏公子如此存心，

en.t: Lady Murasaki had never dreamed that Prince Genji could have such intentions,

units.source_text: 懊恼万分，想道：“这个人如此狠心，

en.t: and in deep distress she thought, "How could this man be so heartless,

units.source_text: 我年来为何一向诚心地信任他呢？”

en.t: and why have I trusted him so sincerely all these years?"
